verdict.rationale: The SOS's own pages say SOSPortal has replaced SOSDirect/SOSUpload and lets users "start a business." Core formation filings such as Form 205 (LLC Certificate of Formation) can be filed online, and all documents can be filed through the portal. The pages also document online payment by ACH and credit card, 24/7 availability, drafts, expedited submission and status tracking via My Submissions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of completing a filing end-to-end, since the filing host itself was not examined.
